name: Komga
tagline: Media server for comics, manga & books
description: Serve your comics, manga, BD and ebooks (CBZ/CBR/PDF/EPUB) with a gorgeous web reader, OPDS support and per-user libraries.
compose:
services:
  komga:
    image: ghcr.io/gotson/komga:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    user: "1000:1000"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.library_dir}}:/data:ro
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
